item.title: How one prompt grew into a company brain: Recall in four generations
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. In one line: it turns “remembering” into a retrieval contract — the source is stored upstream and never edited, the index and sandbox are rebuildable projections, and the server owns recall while precision and citation go back to the frontier model that asked. Source material: the author’s long post, plus the open skill repository (the engine is not open source; the skills are, MIT, 13 of them).
